records.observation:
Extends ScrollableObject; constructor parent(model), cached tRange/tIncrement0, perinstance NumberFormat.getInstance cast DecimalFormat pattern#,##0.00###### (default locale, two minimum/eight maximum fraction digits). No units/adaptive time-unit labels, fontmetric spacing or localization refresh. Static FONT captures Const.FONT at classinit, FONT_SIZE=font.size, baseline=10+size+5, fixed VIEW_HEIGHT=baseline+5. Later parameter/font changes do not refresh these final snapshots. minsize newDimension(0,height), max newDimension32767,height, componentheight fixed. initialize/finalize offimages noops; parent handles three buffered images/scroll/zoom generation.
drawOneOffImage optionaldebug, nullimage no-op. Nonnull gets image width/height/Graphics, fills white, static font, black. If supplied box.duration != cached tRange by dcmpl (NaN always differs), stores duration then tIncrement=Routines.getTimeRulerIncrement(duration/20). Cache only duration, not pixelwidth/font/locale. Rechecked original Routines lines207–286: scale10^ceil(log(v)/log10), ratio=v/scale, selects normalized increment .1/.125/.2/.25/.4/.5/1 using strict thresholds .1125/.1625/.225/.325/.45/.75 then multiplies scale; firstmark=floor(start/increment)*increment. No positivity/finite guards. This supplements existing Routines reading, not new class count.
Stores box.start and its parent ScrollableObject.time2pixel as pixelorigin. First mark at/beforestart for positive valid increment; upperlimit=box.latest+increment; for(time=first;time<upperlimit;time+=increment) dcmpg/ifge exits on NaN. Each x=parent.time2pixel(time)-origin INTEGER subtraction; tick y1..10, formatted time at x-3,staticbaseline; optionalDebug.print(time:x). No explicit clipping/label-overlap check/zero alignment normalization (Graphics/image clipping external). May draw negative x and a mark after latest by up to increment; ordinary parent image extent2*viewextent makes about20 ticks peroffimage, not20 perviewport.
No max tick count, finite bounds, increment>0 or progress test. If finite addition time+increment rounds back tosame time while time<upperlimit, loop can stall; model admits exceptional ranges and helper no safeguards. Zero initial duration keeps initialincrement0 (skips recompute), firstmark 0division yieldsNaN and loop normally exits; do not claim zero range necessarily infinite. Negative/NaN helper can produce NaN skipping ticks. Parent pixelconversion roundlong→int and local subtraction can overflow without clamp. Graphics.dispose ONLY normal loop tail; exceptions or stall bypass release, no finally. Afterloop optionalDebug.println closes buffered line.
getPropertyAt(point,box) IGNORES suppliedbox and delegates inherited getTimePropertyAt(point), resolving superclass TimeInfo path with shared model/currentbuffer, no own dialog show/close wiring. No summary/search support, file access or own model listener in this class. Archived GUI not executed or independently approved.
